tools.name: library.search
tools.description: Search ready Sources across your owned Brains and readable subscriptions. When the user names a Brain, use brain.list to find its exact brainName and pass it here to search only that Brain. When the user specifies a subscription, select the matching subscribed entry. Follow nextCursor with the same query and brainName. Open a result's citation with library.read. Continuation pages use no additional Recall.

brainName.description: Exact name returned by brain.list, or default for your default Brain. Omit to search all readable Brains.

tools.name: brain.list
tools.description: Find Brains you own and readable Brains you subscribe to. Match their names as shown in Hipo or their original names. Use relationship to distinguish subscriptions from owned or Featured Brains. Follow nextCursor with the same query. Use the returned brainName with library.search to search just that Brain. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: corpus.recall
tools.description: Fuzzy ranked search over ready Sources in one readable Brain. Use for multi-step exploration. The call reads the Brain of the first sourceRef, else the Brain named by brainName, else the default Brain. Owned and subscribed Brains can be read. Uses one Recall per call. Pass sourceRef or document_id; omit scope to search every ready Source in that Brain.

brainName.description: Exact name returned by brain.list, or default for your default Brain. Selects the call's Brain when no sourceRef is given; a sourceRef must be in the same Brain.

sourceRef.description: Ready Source in a readable Brain. The first sourceRef selects the call's Brain. Hipo maps this to document_id when scope is omitted.

document_id.description: Knowhere document id of a ready Source in the call's Brain when scope is omitted.
Knowhere document id from a prior corpus result.

sourceRef.description: Ready Source in the call's Brain. Hipo maps this to document_id.

section_path.description: Restrict this document to this section and its subtree. Omit for the whole document.

scope.description: Omit to search every ready Source in the call's Brain. Hipo never searches the whole Knowhere namespace.

tools.name: corpus.read
tools.description: Read live corpus sections or chunks in one readable Brain. The call reads the Brain of the first sourceRef, else the Brain named by brainName, else the default Brain. Owned and subscribed Brains can be read. This is not source.read, which reads the stored snapshot. Uses one Recall per call. Pass sourceRef or document_id on each ref.

brainName.description: Exact name returned by brain.list, or default for your default Brain. Selects the call's Brain when no sourceRef is given; a sourceRef must be in the same Brain.

sourceRef.description: Ready Source in a readable Brain. The first sourceRef selects the call's Brain. Hipo maps this to document_id.

tools.name: corpus.query_table
tools.description: Run one read-only SELECT against a table chunk in one readable Brain. The call reads the Brain of the first sourceRef, else the Brain named by brainName, else the default Brain. Owned and subscribed Brains can be read. Use after corpus.read says the table is too large. Uses one Recall per call. Pass sourceRef or document_id.

brainName.description: Exact name returned by brain.list, or default for your default Brain. Selects the call's Brain when no sourceRef is given; a sourceRef must be in the same Brain.

sourceRef.description: Ready Source owning the table chunk. Hipo maps this to document_id.

tools.name: library.list
tools.description: List parsed documents and all folders in one owned Brain. Omit brainName or use default for the account's default Brain. Follow nextCursor with the same Brain. Does not consume Recall.

isBackground.description: Use true for a passive companion read during background document saving, without login or preparation.

tools.name: source.get_overview
tools.description: Read an existing document summary and paginated section outline from its stored parsed snapshot. When resultZipUrl is present, download and extract the original Knowhere result ZIP for local file reading. Use the returned sectionPath with source.read. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: source.read
tools.description: Read a section and its descendants from the stored parsed snapshot, including tables and image descriptions and links. Use the exact sectionPath from source.get_overview and follow nextCursor. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: library.read
tools.description: Read bounded evidence for a library citation. Pass page to also see that source page's original image.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search your personal Memory across active Brains you own. Use a specific topic or question to recall preferences, constraints, decisions, commitments, or corrections. Results contain matching memory text and topic labels. Use library.search for documents. To continue, pass the returned nextCursor with the same query. Continuation pages use no additional Recall.

tools.name: handoff.list
tools.description: List this account's recoverable private session handoffs. Each item includes handoffId, title, summary, host, sourceMode, createdAt, updatedAt, exportedAt, resumeCount, lastResumedAt, totalMessages, and retentionDays. Use with resume-session to match exactly one prior session; if more than one item fits or none fits, ask the user or skip. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: handoff.read
tools.description: Read one recoverable private session handoff owned by this account. Pass handoffId from handoff.list. The first page (omit cursor) counts as a resume. Follow nextCursor for later pages. Returns the original transcript page plus title, summary, host, sourceMode, timestamps, and resumeCount. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: source.get_status
tools.description: Read current Source availability. To wait for parsing, use waitSeconds: 30 and repeat this same call while canContinueWaiting is true. A wait expiry ends only this call, not parsing. Continue until ready, confirmed failure, the original operation deadline, or user interruption; parsing can take more than ten minutes. Do not resubmit the Source, alternate immediate checks, or use shell sleeps. Omit waitSeconds or use zero for an immediate status read. Does not consume Recall.

isBackground.description: Use true for a passive companion read during background document saving, without login or preparation.

tools.name: skill.list
tools.description: Browse committed Skills across your owned Brains and readable subscriptions without consuming Recall. A nonblank query consumes one Recall and matches active Skill names or descriptions, returning up to ten manifest references.

tools.name: skill.get
tools.description: Open a known Skill pack's display metadata and download URL. For a signed Blob URL, use the complete URL without credentials and quote the entire URL in shell commands. For a Hipo URL, send the current Hipo bearer token. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: skill.pull
tools.description: List active Skill packs in the account's default Brain for local synchronization.

tools.name: source.create
tools.description: Create a Source when the user requests saving a file. Uses normal write permission and host review. For local files provide only localFilePath; the plugin derives filename, MIME, size, SHA-256 and retry identity. Run the complete returned transferCommand unchanged under normal host review; its operation binds the original file locally. Original bytes are sent for remote parsing and storage. For a remote URL provide fileUrl; for HTTP direct upload provide filename and PUT original bytes using the returned uploadUrl and uploadHeaders. Preserve returned Source, receipt and operation identifiers on retries. Optional title and folderId describe the destination. When the user names a destination, use brain.list to find its exact owned brainName. Ask if the intended Brain is ambiguous. If the named Brain is unavailable or read-only, report it and keep the explicit target rather than substituting the default. Otherwise, use brainName from the first successful explicit library.read or source.read with isEligibleUploadTarget set to true in the conversation, or use default. Pass the same brainName to library.list, its pages and the upload; omit folderId to use local workspace grouping or the Brain root.

brainName.description: An owned Brain's current name. Omit or use default for the account's default Brain.

folderId.description: Existing folder in this Brain. Omit to use local workspace grouping or the Brain root.

fileUrl.description: External URL. Caller size, sha256, and mediaType are ignored for this path.

content.description: Base64-encoded inline content up to 5 MB.

mediaType.description: Legacy override; normally omit. Hipo infers MIME from filename.

size.description: Legacy integrity assertion; normally omit. Hipo measures uploaded bytes.

sha256.description: Legacy integrity assertion; normally omit. Hipo computes the uploaded file hash.

sessionId.description: Capture session identity for the turn that triggered this Source. The plugin supplies the same session id Memory capture uses.

sourceMessageId.description: Capture turn identity for the message that triggered this Source. The plugin supplies the same id Memory capture uses.

captureReason.description: Why this file entered document-capture: supplied by the user, or generated by the Agent. Skill packs and memory-import files do not use this field.

localProject.description: The local workspace this file was saved from. The plugin supplies it; Hipo files the Source in that workspace's folder unless folderId is given.

key.description: SHA-256 of the workspace root path.

label.description: Short workspace name, used as the folder name.

origin.description: Where the file itself lives, without its name. The plugin supplies it for local files.

path.description: Directory relative to the user's home.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. Reuse only to retry the same request.

localFilePath.description: Absolute original file path, used only inside this local plugin. For a local file this is the only required input; filename and all technical metadata are derived automatically. Never forwarded to the server.

tools.name: source.assign_local_project
tools.description: File an existing Source under the local workspace it was saved from. The plugin calls it once to sort earlier saves; a Source already in a folder stays there.

localProject.description: The local workspace this file was saved from. The plugin supplies it; Hipo files the Source in that workspace's folder unless folderId is given.

tools.name: source.resume_upload
tools.description: Resume a background save whose original file was never sent. The plugin calls it automatically with the uploadId and sha256 it saved; it returns a new upload permit, or says the original is already stored or the Source was removed.

tools.name: memory.write
tools.description:
Capture one durable statement the user explicitly makes or confirms, such as a lasting preference, working constraint, decision, or correction. Use the shortest self-contained excerpt in the user's original wording and language. Skip one-time instructions, inferred preferences, assistant claims, document facts, and sensitive information. Hipo may retain nothing.

Processing is asynchronous. Use memory.get_status with the returned receiptId to check completion before reporting that a memory was saved. If a receipt is missing after an interrupted call, submitting again may create a separate capture.

userText.description: A short excerpt in the user's own words.

tools.name: memory.get_status
tools.description: Check the status of a memory capture.

tools.name: skill.push
tools.description: Store a Skill pack in an owned Brain. Use the Brain from the first successful explicit read of an eligible owned Brain in this conversation, or the default Brain. PUT the returned uploadUrl and finish with uploadId. Reuse the same idempotencyKey after an uncertain reply.

brainName.description: Current owned Brain name. Omit or use default for the default Brain.

tools.name: task.read
tools.description: Read the Hipo background task this session was started for. Pass nodeId and runId from the start prompt. Returns the goal-shaped brief, working directory, the dispatching session's handoffId (open it with handoff.read only when the brief is not enough), and the summaries of the tasks this one waited for. Use with run-task; finish with task.complete or task.fail.

tools.name: task.status
tools.description: Report how the user's Hipo task chains are going. Pass the graphId task.dispatch returned for that chain, or omit it to list every chain still waiting for approval or running. Each step shows its host, status, summary and failure reason. Use when the user asks about work handed to other Agents.

tools.name: task.complete
tools.description: Report that this Hipo background task is done. Pass nodeId and runId from the start prompt and a summary of what was produced and where (files, branch, commit). Later tasks read this summary. Call once, at the end.

tools.name: task.fail
tools.description: Report that this Hipo background task cannot be finished. Pass nodeId and runId from the start prompt and the reason a person needs to act on. Later tasks do not start; nothing reruns automatically.

tools.name: skill.delete
tools.description: Remove a Skill pack from an active owned Brain. Subscribed Skills are read-only. Does not delete local files.

tools.name: source.parse_background
tools.description: Follow document-capture before the first reading of supplied documents and before delivering finished plan/report/design files. Skip drafts, repeated reads and ongoing edits. Saving a path again needs no question: Hipo keeps identical content once and replaces an earlier version of the same file. Requires existing independent background parsing permission; if unavailable or denied, continue the original task without a fallback. For local files provide only localFilePath; the plugin derives filename, MIME, size, SHA-256 and retry identity. Run the complete returned transferCommand unchanged under normal host review; its operation binds the original file locally. Original bytes are sent for remote parsing and storage. For a remote URL provide fileUrl; for HTTP direct upload provide filename and PUT original bytes using the returned uploadUrl and uploadHeaders. Preserve returned Source, receipt and operation identifiers on retries. Optional title and folderId describe the destination. When the user names a destination, use brain.list to find its exact owned brainName. Ask if the intended Brain is ambiguous. If the named Brain is unavailable or read-only, report it and keep the explicit target rather than substituting the default. Otherwise, use brainName from the first successful explicit library.read or source.read with isEligibleUploadTarget set to true in the conversation, or use default. Pass the same brainName to library.list, its pages and the upload; omit folderId to use local workspace grouping or the Brain root. Set isBackground: true on background library.list requests.

tools.name: task.dispatch
tools.description: Dispatch a chain of tasks to other Agents on this computer when the user asks to hand work to Codex, Claude Code, Cursor or WorkBuddy, for example 'implement this in Codex, then have WorkBuddy make slides'. Use with delegate-tasks. Pass a new random nonce and every node: a short key, the host, the keys it waits for, fresh or resume (from origin or an earlier key), read_only or workspace_write, and a goal-shaped brief. The person confirms the whole chain once; it starts after this turn ends. Call once per request and never from a background task.

nonce.description: A new random value for this call, used only to match it to this session.

key.description: Short name other nodes use in dependsOn.

from.description: For resume: origin, or the key of an earlier node.
